payload.claim: `_COMPARED_KINDS` is restated verbatim here as a second module-level tuple, duplicating `saffron/record/migrate.py`'s own `_COMPARED_KINDS` (lines 66-80). The comment argues this is deliberate so a typo in the production list cannot also hide in the test's expectations, but the standing convention is that a constant the repository already defines is imported, not restated, even when the two values agree today; if the production tuple's order or membership ever changes, this copy can silently drift out of sync rather than being caught by an import failure.
